histogram_quantile(0.90, sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_round_trip_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) by (le, outcome))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_round_trip_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) by (le, outcome))

spec.description: p50/p90/p99 of the technical round-trip, split by reply outcome.
spec.title: Round-trip quantiles by outcome (M17)

spec.title: Release-to-start heatmap (M16)

spec.description: p50/p90/p99 of the release-to-start wait on P_B.
spec.title: Release-to-start quantiles (M16)

spec.expr: sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_duration_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_round_trip_duration_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_round_trip_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_duration_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_round_trip_duration_seconds_sum{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_round_trip_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Mean ask lifetime (M7) minus mean round-trip (M17), both on P_K: the retry/back-off + business-id contention beyond a single round-trip. A directional trend, not an exact split — M7 samples once per ask lifetime, M17 once per reply attempt, so the two means cover different populations.
spec.title: Latency decomposition: retry + contention beyond the round-trip (M7 - M17, P_K)

spec.description: Rate of asks reaching a terminal outcome on P_K (M7 by outcome). 'expired' means the ask stayed blocked the whole message TTL and gave up without starting — the clearest count of starts that never happened under contention.
spec.title: Blocked-ask terminal outcomes: started vs expired (M7, P_K)

spec.expr: sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", outcome="expired"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_asks_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Fraction of terminal asks that expired rather than started (M7 is started|expired only). Climbs toward 1 when the contended business id is never freed within the message TTL. Gaps mean no ask terminated in the window.
spec.title: Expired-ask share (M7, P_K)

spec.expr: sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_requests_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum(rate(zeebe_message_start_cross_partition_replies_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]))

spec.description: Should-be-near-zero reply-loss signals. 'dedup_hit' (M1) is a retried request that matched an existing decision — the earlier STARTED reply was lost. 'request-reply gap' is rate(M1, P_B) minus rate(M2, P_K); a sustained positive gap means replies lost between partitions.
spec.title: Lost-reply indicators (P_K)

spec.description: Should-be-low self-heal and race signals; releases self-heal either way. 'reconciliation release' (M12, P_B) fires when a push was lost or the holder banned/migrated and the poll frees the lock instead — the ADR's designated release-health signal. 'redundant release' (M13, P_K) is a release for a lock already freed or re-acquired.
spec.title: Release self-heal & races (P_B / P_K)

spec.description: Cluster-wide growth slope (deriv, entries/s) of the four handshake-state gauges. A line holding above zero means the structure accumulates faster than it drains — the 'level only grows' leak: pending asks never replied (M4), locks never released (M5), dedup entries never reaped (M6), or business-id index rows never cleaned (M15). Near zero is healthy.
spec.title: Handshake-state growth / leak detector (M4/M5/M6/M15)

spec.description: Number of records which have been exported to the primary RDBMS instance but not the required number of replicas
spec.title: Non-replicated records

spec.description: Average replication lag in milliseconds
spec.title: Async replication lag

spec.description: Number of connected secondary RDBMS instances
spec.title: Connected replicas

spec.expr: sum(increase(atomix_compaction_time_ms_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval]) or increase(atomix_compaction_time_ms_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__rate_interval])) by (le)

spec.description: State of the RdbmsExporter based on the replication lag
spec.title: Rdbms exporter state

spec.expr: max(zeebe_raft_replication_lag_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}) by (physicalTenant, partition, follower)

spec.description: How far behind each follower is in bytes, counting both log replication and snapshot installation. Reported by the partition's leader. This is what a coordinated leadership transfer admits on: a follower above the configured lag threshold is declined with LAG_TOO_HIGH rather than paused behind. It is the byte-sized view of the same distance the non-replicated records gauge counts in records.
spec.title: Follower replication lag

spec.expr: avg(min by (physicalTenant, partition) (zeebe_cluster_partition_balanced{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}))

spec.description: Fraction of partitions currently led by their configured highest-priority replica. 100% is fully balanced. Updated continuously, not just after a rebalance runs.
spec.title: Cluster balance

spec.expr: avg(min by (physicalTenant, partition) (zeebe_cluster_partition_balanced{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}))

spec.description: Cluster balance over time. A successful rebalance ends at 100%; a drop with no rebalance running means leadership moved on its own, by election or a broker restart.
spec.title: Cluster balance over time

spec.description: Rebalances that finished within the selected range, by outcome. COMPLETED reached every partition in scope; CANCELLED was stopped by an operator; FAILED stopped short of its remaining partitions. Reported by the coordinator only, so the pod filter doesn't apply.
spec.title: Cluster rebalances

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(max(zeebe_cluster_rebalance_partition_paused{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}) by (physicalTenant, partition), "partitionSort", "00$1", "partition", "([0-9])"), "partitionSort", "0$1", "partition", "([0-9][0-9])"), "partitionSort", "$1", "partition", "([0-9][0-9][0-9])")

spec.description: When each partition was frozen for a leadership transfer - writes are declined while the desired leader catches up, so this is the partition's unavailability window. Unlike the processing phase panel, this only counts pauses a transfer caused.
spec.title: Partitions paused for transfer

spec.description: Progress of the most recent (or currently running) rebalance, per partition: Pending, Transferring, or Completed. Transfers run one at a time, so a healthy rebalance shows one partition Transferring while later ones wait and earlier ones show Completed. State persists after the rebalance ends until the next one starts. For a completed partition's actual outcome, see the transfer outcomes table below.
spec.title: Last rebalance state per partition

spec.expr: round(sum by (physicalTenant, partition, result) (increase(zeebe_cluster_rebalance_partition_duration_seconds_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}[$__range])))

spec.description: Outcome of each partition a rebalance attempted, within the selected range. TRANSFERRED is success; other results explain why leadership stayed put: CANCELLED means the operator stopped the rebalance first; LAG_TOO_HIGH and REPLICATION_TIMED_OUT point at the follower replication lag panel in the Raft row; NO_RESPONSE and NO_LEADER mean the leader, or the topology, never answered; PHYSICAL_TENANT_DISABLED means the partition's physical tenant was disabled after the rebalance was planned; PHYSICAL_TENANT_RECOVERING means the partition's physical tenant entered recovery after the rebalance was planned.
spec.title: Partition transfer outcomes

spec.description: How long partitions stayed frozen while the desired leader caught up - what a rebalance costs in availability. Watch this when tuning the replication timeout or lag threshold.
spec.title: Partition pause duration

spec.expr: sum by (le) (clamp_min((zeebe_cluster_rebalance_partition_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", result!~"ALREADY_LEADER|CANCELLED|PHYSICAL_TENANT_DISABLED|PHYSICAL_TENANT_RECOVERING"} - (zeebe_cluster_rebalance_partition_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", result!~"ALREADY_LEADER|CANCELLED|PHYSICAL_TENANT_DISABLED|PHYSICAL_TENANT_RECOVERING"} offset $__rate_interval)) or zeebe_cluster_rebalance_partition_duration_seconds_bucket{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", result!~"ALREADY_LEADER|CANCELLED|PHYSICAL_TENANT_DISABLED|PHYSICAL_TENANT_RECOVERING"}, 0))

spec.description: How long the rebalance spent on each partition, from deciding to act on it to knowing what became of it. Includes time spent waiting on a leader that answered slowly or not at all. Partitions resolved without contacting anyone, or left untouched by a cancellation, aren't counted here - see the transfer outcomes table for those.
spec.title: Partition rebalance duration

spec.description: Approximate Install RPC as measured by the follower.
spec.title: Snapshot Replication Duration

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(min by (physicalTenant, partition) (zeebe_cluster_partition_balanced{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition"}), "partitionSort", "00$1", "partition", "([0-9])"), "partitionSort", "0$1", "partition", "([0-9][0-9])"), "partitionSort", "$1", "partition", "([0-9][0-9][0-9])")

spec.description: Per-partition balance: whether each partition is led by its configured leader. A partition with no leader counts as unbalanced. Leadership and configuration are gossiped separately, so brokers can briefly disagree right after either one changes.
spec.title: Partition leadership balance

spec.expr: sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_cache_hit{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition) / clamp_min(sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_cache_hit{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition) + sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_cache_miss{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition), 1e-9)

spec.description:
Share of block cache lookups served without touching the filesystem. A high ratio means the read path is CPU bound rather than IO bound, which is the question that decides whether shaving allocations or copies is worth anything.

Only present when RocksDB statistics are enabled.
spec.title: Block cache hit ratio

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_cache_index_hit{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition)

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_cache_index_miss{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition)

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_cache_filter_hit{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition)

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_cache_filter_miss{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition)

Data, index and filter block lookups split by hit and miss. Index and filter blocks are pinned in cache, so sustained misses there point at a cache that is too small for the working set.

Only present when RocksDB statistics are enabled.
spec.title: Block cache hits and misses by block type

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_reads_hit_l1{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition)

Gets resolved by the memtable versus each LSM level. Everything below the memtable line went through the block cache or the filesystem.

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_bloom_useful{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition) / clamp_min(sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_bloom_useful{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition) + sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_bloom_full_positive{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition), 1e-9)

Fraction of bloom lookups that avoided reading a block. The prefix extractor is a fixed 8-byte prefix, which is the column family id only, so a prefix ratio near zero means the prefix bloom is spending memtable memory without filtering anything.

Only present when RocksDB statistics are enabled.

Every whileEqualPrefix / whileTrue call constructs a fresh iterator, which acquires a superversion and builds a merging iterator over the memtables and L0 files. This is a fixed per-call cost that is paid even when the scan returns a single entry.

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_iterators_reseek{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition)

Seeks, forward and backward steps, plus internal keys skipped and re-seeks. A high skip or reseek rate relative to next means iteration is walking over tombstones or shadowed versions.

Only present when RocksDB statistics are enabled.
spec.title: Iterator steps

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_iterators_bytes_read_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition)

Bytes read through point gets compared with bytes read through iterators. Tells you which of the two read paths is worth optimising.

Only present when RocksDB statistics are enabled.

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_writes_keys{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition)

Key throughput as seen by RocksDB itself, independent of Zeebe record throughput.

Only present when RocksDB statistics are enabled.

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_histogram_db_seek_sum_ms{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition) / clamp_min(sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_histogram_db_seek_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition), 1e-9)

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_histogram_db_write_sum_ms{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition) / clamp_min(sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_histogram_db_write_count{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition), 1e-9)

spec.description:
Mean time spent inside RocksDB per operation, derived as rate(sum)/rate(count) over the query window. This excludes the JNI boundary and Zeebe serialization, so comparing it against zeebe_rocksdb_latency_seconds separates RocksDB cost from Zeebe-side cost.

Mean time for a single SST file read and for fetching a block on behalf of a get. A rising mean here is the clearest sign that reads are leaving the block cache and hitting the filesystem.

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_files_last_level_reads{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition)

sum(rate(zeebe_rocksdb_files_non_last_level_reads{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", physicalTenant=~"$physicalTenant", partition=~"$partition", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod, physicalTenant, partition)

SST file opens and read errors, plus how many reads are served from the last (compressed) level versus the levels above it.
